summary: Tested compliance readiness, typed signature, job documents, external systems, and onboarding checklist features. All 20 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified for readiness card and typed signature section. Fixed bug: OfferResponse model in server.py was missing typed_signature field.

integration_issues.issue: Login form submission doesn't redirect properly in Playwright automation (works manually). Token-based auth workaround used for testing.
integration_issues.priority: LOW - Manual login works, automation issue only

tests: test_readiness_standard_bundle_items - PASSED (8 items: BLS, ACLS, RN License, TB Test, Vaccinations, Gov ID, Background, Drug Screen)

seeker_dashboard_readiness.item_badges: PASS - 8 badges with checkmarks (✓) for complete, circles (○) for missing

offers_page_typed_signature.legal_text: PASS - 'By typing your full legal name below, you agree to the terms of this offer and authorize VitalaMatch to process your acceptance.'

bug_fixed.issue: OfferResponse model in server.py missing typed_signature field
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'typed_signature: Optional[str] = None' to OfferResponse model
bug_fixed.impact: Offer acceptance was returning 500 error instead of 400 when typed_signature validation failed

features_verified.seeker_readiness_score: GET /api/seeker/readiness returns score, level, message, items with status per compliance bundle item
features_verified.readiness_vault_integration: Score correctly identifies complete (vault docs exist) vs missing items
features_verified.typed_signature_required: PUT /api/hiring/offers/{id}/respond requires typed_signature for acceptance (400 if missing)
features_verified.typed_signature_stored: Offer acceptance stores typed_signature and signature_timestamp
features_verified.onboarding_checklist: GET /api/onboarding/{case_id}/checklist returns grouped checklist (documents, tasks, external)
features_verified.checklist_item_update: PUT /api/onboarding/{case_id}/items/{item_id}/status updates item and recomputes case status
features_verified.ui_readiness_card: Dashboard shows readiness card with score percentage and item badges
features_verified.ui_readiness_badges: Green checkmarks for complete, gray circles for missing
features_verified.ui_upload_button: Readiness card has 'Upload Documents' button linking to vault
features_verified.ui_typed_signature: Offer acceptance dialog has typed signature section with legal text
features_verified.ui_signature_validation: Cannot accept offer without typing full name (frontend validation + backend 400)
